newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle lightly traded at $113, $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle lightly traded at $113, $71 - USDA.

text.p: Nebraska cattle were lightly traded at $113.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and $71.00 on a live basis, which feedlot sources said were steady with Wednesday closes.
"The market deteriorated throughout the day yesterday," said a feedlot source.
A few confinement cattle, that should grade 70 percent choice, sold at $116.00 Thursday, sources said.
USDA reported top prices Wednesday ranged from $115.00 to $116.00 on a dressed basis with a few at $118.00 and from $70.00 to $71.00 on a live basis.
